invariants.rationale: instantTime is immediately used as a parameter, so must not be null.
partitionPath is likely used further and is required to identify data partitions.
fileId is used to identify a file and is passed to IOUtils.runMerge.
keyToNewRecords is a map used to specify updates, so it should not be null.
oldDataFile is used as an argument in getUpdateHandle, so should not be null.
